mapper.select: insert into jsh_sequence (seq_name, min_value, max_value, current_val, increment_val, remark) values (#{seqName}, 1, 999999, 1, 1, '每日单据编号') on conflict (seq_name) do update set current_val = jsh_sequence.current_val + jsh_sequence.increment_val where jsh_sequence.current_val < jsh_sequence.max_value returning current_val
